title: narrative_blocks
description: v1.0 — the prose blocks the Insights agent emits, consumed by the HTML splicer. Schema locked 2026-05-21; see DECISIONS.md entry 21.

schema_version.description: Version tag so the splicer knows how to handle future shape changes.

main_conclusions.description: Top section of the dashboard. One headline plus 4-6 bullets, leading with what's improving, ending with the single highest-leverage opportunity.

title.description: The bullet's bold one-liner. Lead with the finding.

body.description: Two to three sentences. Plain language. Numbers carry units. No comma separators in numerals. Period-aggregate comparisons forbidden. If the week has data-adequacy caveats (partial week, sparse productive hours), weave them into the body of the relevant bullet rather than as a separate banner — the rate is still valid (Decision 1); the caveat is informational.

top_3_actions.description: Three concrete actions, in priority order. The first one is the highest-leverage thing to address next.

body.description: What to do, why, and what to look at on the floor.

drivers_insight.description: The single diagnostic insight about what drives week-to-week variance in the loss rate.

patterns.description: Intro paragraphs for the Patterns tab, one per section. Each leads with the BEST shift / day, then contrasts with the worst.

by_shift_intro.description: Pattern 1 intro. Lead with the cleanest shift; contrast with the slowest. Numbers carry units.

by_weekday_intro.description: Pattern 2 intro. Lead with the cleanest weekday; contrast with the worst. Mention weekend caveat if relevant.

per_shift_trend_intro.description: Per-shift trend intro. Reports per-shift OLS slopes for the loss rate, plus the per-shift presence trend. Use the methodology's flat threshold.
